rows.text: The Lok Sabha Secretariat notifies, by S.O. 1724(E) dated 30 July 2012 [F. No. 21/1/2012/T] and signed by T. K. Viswanathan, Secretary-General, that consequent upon assuming Office of the President of India, Shri Pranab Mukherjee, Member for the Janjipur constituency of West Bengal, ceased to be a Member of Lok Sabha with effect from 25 July 2012 in terms of clause (1) of Article 59.
